Done.

**Root cause.** `updateTerminal` (`variants/bug07/movegen.inc:1180`) called `moverInCheck`, which ignores the `A` register and tests `sideToMove XOR 8` — the side that just moved, and therefore never in check after a legal move — so the mate test was unconditionally false and every checkmate fell through to the stalemate branch. Fix: `call moverInCheck` → `call inCheckSide` (one instruction; `moverInCheck` left alone, correct at its 5 other call sites).

**Violated clause:** C11 (`terminal`). The contract already specified the correct rule (`inCheckSide p p.stm`), so no clause was added or changed — the contract delta is witness and regression pinning only.
